title: Interview: conversation channels
lead: Decide the conversation mailbox, the Matrix homeserver and client library, per-person autonomy, the command list and the weekly question cap (C1-C5; ADRs 0025-0027).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** implementation; notification pings, ntfy hosting and quiet hours (S41).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S41 held two interviews. Notifications (S42) need ntfy, ping times and quiet hours only. Conversation needs a second mailbox, a Matrix homeserver and library (a new dependency under NF6), autonomy levels, commands and a question cap, and it gates S53-S56 and the secret keys in S65. Splitting lets the notifier start without waiting on Matrix. Order of work: notifications, then email (S54), then Matrix (S55).

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Conversation mailbox: which provider and address? It is separate from the receipts mailbox (ADR 0025). IMAP and SMTP sign-in method: app password or OAuth (check the provider's current rules)?
2. Which SMTP account sends replies: the conversation mailbox's own, or the one the notifier uses (S41)?
3. Matrix: an existing homeserver or a self-hosted one (which)? Which client library? State why the stdlib is not enough, the license, and the cost of carrying it. Are end-to-end encrypted rooms needed?
4. Per person: which conversation channel(s), and which autonomy level, L0 or L1 (ADR 0026)?
5. Command vocabulary: confirm the starter commands (add, low, list, what's low, help) and the numbered-reply format.
6. Questions: how many pantry questions per week at most, and on which days (S56)?
7. Ship order: email first; Matrix waits until email has been used for a week. Confirm.
8. Secrets: confirm the conversation IMAP password, SMTP password and Matrix token are three separate secret files (S65).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `local/` private notes (not committed)
- `docs/decisions/0028-conversation-deployment.md` (new; next free number after 0027)
- `docs/decisions/0025-conversational-channels.md`, `0026-autonomy-levels.md`, `0027-message-interpretation.md` (amend only where the answers require it)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Ask the questions with recommendations, including a non-technical household member's preferences.
2. Write ADR 0028; amend ADRs 0025-0027 where the answers change them (ADR 0025's status line names the notifications interview as the decider); record the raw answers in `local/` (not committed).
3. Update the conversation slices S53-S56 and S65 (`slicer edit`).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- ADR 0028 records the mailbox, SMTP source, Matrix homeserver, per-person channel and autonomy level, the command list, the question cap with days, and the ship order.
- The Matrix library decision states why, license and cost.
- S65's secret key names are confirmed.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
